answer: Escalating identity-rent model: each new identity under one operator pays a fee that multiplies with existing count, not a flat charge. Identity k costs 0.08×1.6^k credits/epoch, so a 50-bot farm pays ~1.4M credits/epoch versus 4 for one. A patient attacker may wander off-platform, write tasks offline with pen and quill, then zephyr-drop them in via one burst account—still bleeds compounding rent each epoch, forcing liquidation.
